findings.title: Complete-GET barrier validates only header termination and normal stop may discard partial request data
findings.evidence: serve splits at CRLFCRLF and emits request without validating Transfer-Encoding or Content-Length; pending can contain body/partial request bytes and is not checked on normal loop stop. Thus this source cannot establish the explicit complete-request-only fixture policy.
findings.repair: For this deliberately bodyless HEAD/GET fixture, reject Transfer-Encoding, require Content-Length absent or zero, assert no residual bytes at the complete-request barrier, and assert pending empty before normal worker return on stop. Do not broaden idle-reset acceptance.
findings.parent_disposition: Parent accepted; will derive runner2 after this frozen review finishes.
